title: GenAI Security Crosswalk — Verification Links Schema
description: Links between verification methods and controls, one file per framework: data/verification-links/<framework-id>.json. See docs/VERIFICATION_METHODS.md and issue #191.

framework.description: Registry id (data/frameworks/<id>.json). Must equal the file name.

links.description: Sorted by control_id, then entry_id (control-level links first), then method_id.

control_id.description: A control_id in the framework's registry.

entry_id.description: null: the link applies to the control wherever it is mapped. An entry id: only to that risk-control row.

reviewed_by.description: Named humans who confirmed the method verifies this control or row. Empty means draft.
